reviews.text: We brought Sammi in for a bath and it was a great experience for her and us. Sammi got the basic bath and liked it. It came with getting her nails done too. We were very happy with Scenthound and plan to return every month. The manager who dealt with us was excellent and she explained everything in simple but thorough terms. I think her name was Nai but regardless she was so nice and helpful.
My little dog came back perfectly coiffed and they fixed the botched cut from the previous groomer. Plus the price is great, love having the option of a regular monthly appointment, I signed up.

The service was Personable and perfect. The receptionist took her time to explain the process Which was nice. And oh my goodness, it was less than an  hour … Which was long enough for my grand dog. It was my first time and I will be back and consider considering buying the membership.
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We look forward to continuing to support Gigi’s wellness journey.
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We look forward to continuing to support Pepe & Lily’s wellness journey.
Thank you for your rating, Michaela. We look forward to continuing to support Charlotte's wellness journey.
Great people, quick and fast! Received great recommendations and information. Best part my dog was happy!  Love this place!
Thank you for your rating, Joyce. We look forward to continuing to support your dog's wellness journey.

I have been taking my dogs here for a while now & every time they come out smelling amazing and looking good! They take great care of the animals and they keep you updated on their health. I would recommend to anyone who is looking for a dog groomer. The staff are very friendly & the membership saves you a lot of money and is definitely worth it.
Excellent experience. I’ll be a repeat customers for sure. My pups loved it.

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We’re glad to be part of your dog’s wellness journey and look forward to seeing you both again.Hi Karen thanks for reviewing us! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience and look forward to seeing you again soon! - Scenthound River Oaks team
Fantastic place with wonderful customer service! And they do an amazing job with our dogs!

It’s fantastic and very affordable for our area. I have a golden doodle and a Standard poodle that I have been taking to Scenthound for around two months. We previously got them groomed at The Pet Barber. Scenthound has been fantastic for weekly/every other week washing, and we just utilized them for a groom for the first time. Our dogs look great!
Did great. Eko was still a little wet after pick up, but besides that it was perfect! Staff is super sweet, price is right and my lil bestie had a blast.
They are very kind and my girls looked beautiful
Friendly and helpful staff. Great experience for me and my dog!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating, Amanda. We look forward to seeing you and your pup again and continuing to support their wellness journey.
My dog was long overdue for a nail grind, and Nyah was wonderful. She handled everything perfectly and really put my dog at ease.
Wonderful service my pup was so happy we will return again

The did excellent job! I am so pleased my 14 years old baby hair cut got so awesome finished. The also did some basic check his heath and everything is perfect vs other ones experience I have. He was sooo messy.

I recently moved and this place was a bit closer to my new residence than the groomer I have been going to for over a year now. I asked to show a picture of how I like my dog’s haircut, the front desk staff (who were very kind and professional), told me the groomer was with another dog and took a photo of the photo and told me they would show them. I come to pick my dog up and low and behold, they did not follow the picture I showed at all. They did take her back and fix it, but overall, for the price, you really do not get anything extra from this place than a small business groomer, who overall end up doing a much better job and care a lot more about the customer’s preferences. A lot of Scenthound’s services, such as their “plaque reduction treatments” are a scam. Will be making the drive to my regular groomer and not trying any new places again lol. Highly recommend The Tailored Tail to anyone looking for a highly qualified groomer who cares deeply about her customer’s preferences and satisfaction.
Excellent service, very nice people and good price
Thanks for trusting our team with your dog's care. We look forward to seeing your dog again. - Scenthound Meyerland!

This place is top notch; from scheduling my first appointment, to providing vaccine documentation, appointment reminders and, my actual appointment. The staff were
friendly, professional and informative. I was hooked when asked to smell four different fragrances, and pick my favorite, to be used on my dog. They spent extra time with my dog as she is blind and has lost her ability to hear. They are more than groomers, they are a health care establishment taking great care of their clients.
My sweet Dorothy girl loves coming here! She always comes out smelling amazing and looking adorable ❤️ Love Juanita at the front desk!!

I love the membership option. There have been some confusion and extra phone calls but my conversations with the owner have been amazing. I’m on satisfied customer at both locations, meyerland and river oaks!!!

Wonderful service & friendly staff each time I bring my lab here. I love their package for the bath, brush, nail clipping, ear cleaning, and blow dry! I appreciate their easy scheduling system and fast service. I know that my dog is so well taken care with them.
They did a great job on my golden doodle, Amy. She was matted, and her fur was long. I was updated about her grooming during the procedure. The personnel are informative and delightfully friendly.
Thank you for the positive rating, Rob. We look forward to continuing to support your dog's wellness journey. -Scenthound River Oaks!

My dog is very excitable/ energetic and can be considered overwhelming for most people, so I was very happy to hear that the team loved her and thought she was just a peach! She had some fear with the blow dryer and nail trimming but still thought of the staff as her best friends after everything!
Great work. great price. nice people 10/10
Thank you for your feedback, Joana. We'd appreciate the chance to go over your concerns as we’re committed to enhancing our client experiences. We hope to see you and Cloud again soon.
This team has always had each pups health and comfort in mind, so glad I trust them with my fur baby! Definitely ask about their membership options!

I was so scared to bring my baby here since I’ve been to other locations and they almost chopped off my babies ear.. literally he had a huge cut that needed medical attention. Anywho, I went here since this is my home location. They did not disappoint. My groomer was a brown skin lady I did not get her name but she did such a good job. Schnauzers can be extremely difficult to cut, and she gave him the perfect schnauzer cut that he has not had an over two years.

Hi Oscar, thank you for posting your positive review. Our team here at Scenthound River Oaks is committed to providing high-quality customer service, and we’re thrilled to hear that we made a good impression on you. We hope you’ll visit us again soon.
Hi Donald thanks for reviewing us! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience and look forward to seeing you again soon!

This place was great and they loved my dog and my dog loved them!! They were thorough in informing me of my dog’s overall health.

I stumbled upon this establishment when actually trying to find another grooming place. I was able to get my fur baby in same day, and she came out happy with all services performed within 35 mins of dropping her off. Super convenient location and genius business model for those who don’t need all out grooming services all the time. We will definitely be returning and even considering membership!

I recently tried Scenthound River Oaks out as my neighbor referred me. They did a good job with bathing my pup and he smelled amazing! They didn't cut the hair around his eyes short enough. I had to do it cut more once I got home.

I took my dog here twice for grooming, nail trimming, teeth cleaning, and gland expression. Found out later at the vet that they didn’t cut his dew claw nails and they were so overgrown that they curled into his skin was hurting him so he was licking his paws non stop. For $150 per visit I’d expect them to at least be thorough about trimming his nails. I switched him to another local groomer close-by who’s half the price and much more thorough.
Thank you for giving us a 5-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and look forward to your next visit.
Very professional and super friendly.
Great service! It was my dogs first time at a groomers and the woman at the front desk who helped us throughout the process was super kind and thoughtful. Plan to visit again.
The girls up front were nice and a huge help. Our dog came out smelling and feeling amazing as well. Highly recommended!
Thank you for giving us a 5-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and we look forward to Aleka's next visit! :)

ScentHound is a gem! Exceptional care and attention for my pet's nail care. The staff is friendly, gentle, and truly cares. Highly recommend for an stress-free and positive experience. They love my xolo Pepita so much and she always has a positive experience when I take her in
They are so sweet and took excellent care of my princess Athena ♥️

The first time I tried this service, it was excellent, and they put in the time the first time to try and get you into membership. The last two times, the service was done in 15 minutes, and my dog smelled worse. Nowhere near a $60 service. I came home and brushed her for 40 minutes and applied my own fragrance.

They seem more focused on upselling add-ons and products and providing a good base service. I recommend finding a local small business; I expect much better service and attention to detail.
Incompetent.
My dogs came back smelling and looking great!   Definitely buying into the subscriptions.
Lily loved it!

This was Dallas first appointment there after a traumatic experience at a big box groomer. They were not able to do everything service wise because of his anxiety but I absolutely LOVE the patience and care they showed him and they are willing to keep working with him through his anxiety. He was so so happy when I picked him up! Dallas will definitely be their fur-ever client ❤️
Thank you for giving us a 5-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and look forward to your next visit. 🐶❤ …
my furr baby loved her self care day she was so soft and super happy when I picked her up
Wonderful staff and the manager was absolutely a superstar

My pup ended up with stitches after leaving here! Groomer was unwelcoming from the beginning. Within 10 minutes of me dropping my dog off, they called to say she needed to go to the hospital for being cut. The groomer cut her neck which resulted in stitches. Would never return nor recommend this establishment. The start of the cut was sloppy and I found another groomer that took their time and provided an amazing, professional experience.

Greetings Cora, We appreciate the time you took to give us such a great rating! We're always happy to help so don't hesitate to contact us if you ever need anything. We hope to continue exceeding your expectations with great service. Hope you visit Scenthound Meyerland again soon!

Rachel, Thanks for choosing us and leaving such a great rating! It's great to know that we were able to provide you with the highest levels of service at Scenthound River Oaks. We look forward to seeing you and Luna again soon!

Very disappointed service wise. Staff was friendly, but i expected better quality.
For $39 you get a double wash, nails, ears and teeth clean. We had an appointed at 3:30 and all of it was finished in 15 minutes. He did not smell very clean and still had that dog smell. I felt like more time could have been used towards the service.

Update:
The staff reached out and let us know we could get an additional wash at no charge to try again, and with a different tech as well. I do appreciate the commitment from them.

Update 12/5
We had another groom with a different tech. We had Vince. This groom was 10/10. Dillans fur smelled and felt clean. He looked amazing. This was quality work we expected, and hope to continue to see !

I initially had a really good experience with my pup here at Scenthound River Oaks but the second appointment in October landed us at the vet with an expensive bill after learning that big cotton balls were left in my dogs ears after the grooming appointment which we found 20 days after the service because they were so deeply lodged in, which lead to an inner canal ear infection. we are still in the road for recovery. I understand that everyone is human and makes mistakes but this one seemed very careless especially with the six-point SCENT check score that we all receive at the end of the appointment. The check seems almost fake as the ears were rated high. I did contact the manager and they are aware of the situation and I did cancel my membership here as I lost my trust. Hopefully the team will be more careful and thorough with everyone’s fur babies after this situation!

My dog was happy and enjoyed  the staff with her grooming and for her to want go to back she really loved and wanted all special  attention  I will always bring my dog here cause she's happy with the service.shes all American Pit bull Gray.
Always very nice and informative for the care of our 4 dogs. Excellent care and an absolute great experience for our babies and us. Glad I found them.
Great service and customer service

Hey Debra, We are grateful and appreciate the time you took to leave your review. It is truly touching to know you think so highly of us! We look forward to providing you with more great experiences in the near future. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

Greetings Nicole, Thank you for the awesome feedback. It's great to know that we were able to provide you with the highest levels of service. Our goal will always be to provide the best experience and we love knowing yours was no different. See you next time!

Great new grooming spot in our neighborhood!
I recently took my dog to Scenthound River Oaks and was really impressed. The salon is super clean, no bad smells, and they always check vaccination records, which makes me feel safe about my dog’s health.

I loved their holistic approach—they checked my dog’s coat, skin, teeth, nails, and glands, and gave helpful recommendations. My dog is 4 years old, and I’ve never seen such a thorough health check at a groomer before, only at the vet.

The service was fantastic, Josh at reception was so friendly and patient, explaining everything in detail. You can tell they really care about the animals and want to keep customers happy.

They also explained the membership options clearly without any pressure, which I appreciated.

Everything was done quickly—my dog was ready in 1.5 hours. We asked for a few small adjustments, and they handled it right away, no problem. My Yorkie Matilda got the best cut she’s had in years—she usually comes out looking like a little mouse..

They also have a convenient app where you can book an appointment there.

Highly recommend this place, and wishing the owners all the success in their business!

Dear Maria, We're delighted to hear about your experience! It is truly touching to know you think so highly of us! We truly value your recommendation, and are confident we can continue to provide excellent service in the future. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

We had a good experience with our 1 year old Pomsky! The Scentshound staff was great with him!  He was overdue for a haircut so he definitely needed attention. However, the haircut was a bit choppy as his breed is known for their long thick fur. FYI - you have to schedule the blow dry ahead of time! We made the mistake and picked him up when he was damp. Wished they would have dried him off as a courtesy just because of his type of breed. Unfortunately, we decided to cancel our membership.

Hey lazaro, We are grateful and appreciate the time you took to leave your review. We appreciate your recognition and will do our best to keep up the great work! We work hard to provide customers with a great experience and look forward to continuing to do the same for you! It was a pleasure to serve you.

Mr. Duke & I love the staff and concept of Scenthound! I enjoy that they text when the pup is ready so they don’t have to sit in a kennel. The staff is very knowledge and so sweet! Duke loves his monthly check-ins!
Knowledgeable and friendly staff
Josh was very thorough and helpful!
Excellent, effecient service. Friendly staff. My guy came out fresh and clean. Will be back many times.

Hey Imran, We're delighted to hear about your experience! It's great to know that we were able to provide you with the highest levels of service. As always, our team is looking forward to your next visit. See you next time!
First Time Experience….Every Thing was Explained and That is Exactly as it went! 45 minutes-full service and ready for pickup!  Just enough to run an errand or grab a bite to eat.
Easy to make appointments, they are quick, and polite. The dogs are well groomed. Their  6 point check covers everything.
